content: Dart/RxDart: a plain broadcast StreamController does not replay, so a late subscriber sees nothing until the next event and reads stale state. RxDart solves it with BehaviorSubject/ValueStream, which caches the latest value and emits it to each new listener. That type cannot appear in a dependency-free domain port, so the equivalent hand-rolled shape is a synchronous current-value accessor paired with a non-replaying changes stream, with the accessor written before the event is emitted.
